messages:
Anita: Heads-up — Gullwing (34B) GA is scheduled Tue 10:00 UTC for eu-west-1. Early perf runs show token/sec ~230k vs current live models ~75k, so roughly 3x baseline.
Evan: 3x is rough. Do we have breakdown by seq length / model variant?
Anita: Short runs: 70% short prompts (<256), 25% mid, 5% long. Token mix amplified peak. Variant used for perf is gullwing-v1 (fp16).
Marcus: If peak T/s jumps 3x, our current pool in eu-west-1 has ~40% spare GPUs — not enough. Recommend pre-warming +50% GPUs and enable burst capacity for first 48–72h.
Sophie: Ballpark cost for the extra 50% for 72h?
Anita: Quick calc: extra GPUs = 0.5 * 80 = 40 GPUs. GPU-hours = 40 * 72 = 2880 GPU-hours. At $2.15/hr estimate ~ $6,192. Add networking egress ~ $600.
Evan: Do we need any config changes? Auto-scaler, batching, or cache tweaks?
Marcus: Auto-scaler defaults will be too slow for sharp ramp. Set aggressive scale-up: min_replicas +30, target_cpu/token_util threshold lower from 0.8 -> 0.65, cooldown 30s. Also set transient-burst policy to allow temporary 1.5x capacity.
Anita: Also enable prefix KV cache for common system prompts — cuts re-compute on long convs. Enable continuous batching with max_latency 30ms to keep p95 latency in check.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-05-12T09:55Z for gullwing-v1 to eu-west-1. Notifying on-call.
Sophie: Any region fallback plan? If eu-west-1 saturated, route low-tier traffic to us-east-1 but only for non-PII customers. Need ACL + privacy check.
Marcus: Agree. Set smart-routing policy: prefer local, fallback to us-east if latency < 120ms and model variant compatible. Also add rate-limit per-customer to 10 rps for first 24h post-GA.
Evan: Network note: we saw packet drops yesterday in one spine rack — can we avoid scheduling new pre-warm nodes on that hardware?
Anita: Ops flagged that rack; will add placement constraint: avoid rack-id rck-17 until hardware replacement.
Sophie: Post-mortem plan if latency/regressions: 1) Pause rollout 2) Rollback to fallback model 3) Throttle new sessions 4) Open incident channel.
Marcus: I'll prepare a short runbook and cost tracking dashboard. Suggest a live cost counter and token/sec chart pinned in Console for the first 96h.
Anita: Quick summary action items: 1) Pre-warm +50% GPUs in eu-west-1 (Marcus) 2) Aggressive scale-up policy + burst enabled (Marcus) 3) KV caching & batching tweaks (Anita) 4) Add rack exclusion (Anita/Ops) 5) Smart-routing fallback to us-east-1 + ACL (Sophie) 6) Cost dashboard (Marcus) 7) Monitor p50/p95/p99 token latency and token/sec (Evan).
Evan: I'll add alerts: token/sec spike >2x baseline for >3min, p95 latency >750ms, error rate >0.5% -> page on-call.
infra-bot: alert: autoscaler cooldown updated by Marcus at 2026-05-11T18:03Z.
Sophie: Thx team. Will loop in Sales for messaging and Dedicated customers who may want reserved capacity.
Anita: Thanks — will follow up with exact GPU counts and a short runbook before EOD.
